# Albiox

> > Albiox supplies pharmaceutical-grade packaging, cleanroom equipment, sterile products, and laboratory consumables for GMP-compliant healthcare and pharmaceutical environments.

Albiox specializes in products for aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing, including NRFit and Luer lock syringe systems, cytotoxic spill management, tamper-evident packaging solutions, and cleanroom PPE. The company serves pharmaceutical compounding facilities, hospital pharmacies, and laboratory environments requiring sterile, GMP-compliant products.

## Key Topics

- GMP manufacturing and compliance
- Pharmaceutical packaging and closures
- Tamper-evident sealing systems
- NRFit and Luer lock connectors
- Cytotoxic spill containment
- Cleanroom PPE and Tyvek garments
- Sterile syringe systems (StaClear)
- HDPE and PP28 closures
- UV-protective amber packaging
- Biological sample transport
- Cleanroom disinfectants and detergents
- Cell-based assay kits
- Sterility testing media
- European PPE standards (CE marking)
- PharmaPack pharmaceutical containers

## Syringes & Injection Systems

- [StaClear® syringe 0,25ml](https://albiox.com/product/staclear-syringe-025ml): StaClear 0.25ml intravitreal syringe with TriboLink-Si coating technology
- [Single packed syringe 1ml-100ml (clear/amber)](https://albiox.com/product/single-packed-syringe-1ml-100ml-clear-amber): Individually packaged syringes 1ml-100ml in clear or amber options
- [Caps Archives](https://albiox.com/products/syringes-needles-caps-connectors-adapters-bins/caps-syringes-needles-caps-connectors-adapters-bins): Syringe and IV caps including NRFit, Luer lock, and CADD cassette caps
- [Syringe transporters](https://albiox.com/product/syringe-transporters-5): PETG pre-filled syringe transporters for sterile/non-sterile transport

## Pharmaceutical Packaging & Closures

- [Screw cap HDPE PP28 white](https://albiox.com/product/screwcap-hdpe-pp28-white-tamper-evident): HDPE screw cap with PP28 thread and tamper evident closure mechanism
- [Steri-Tamp® 28mm vial seal sterile - blue](https://albiox.com/product/steri-tamp-sterile-seal-28-mm-blue): Steri-Tamp 28mm sterile tamper-evident seal for admixture vials
- [Tamper resistant tape](https://albiox.com/product/tamper-resistant-tape-1-roll): TampAlerT tamper-evident tape with serrated edges for security detection
- [UV light inhibiting amber bags Archives](https://albiox.com/products/plastic-bags/uv-light-inhibiting-bags): Photoprotective UV barrier amber bags and IV infusion covers catalog
- [Polycarbonate containers for the transport of biological samples](https://albiox.com/product/polycarbonate-containers-for-the-transport-of-biological-samples): Triple packaging compliant polycarbonate containers for biological transport

## Cleanroom PPE & Apparel

- [Clothing Archives](https://albiox.com/products/personal-protective-equipment/clothing): Cleanroom clothing and PPE including Tyvek suits and sterile garments
- [Cleanroom underwear T-shirt long](https://albiox.com/product/cleanroom-underwear-t-shirt-long): ISO 7 antistatic cleanroom long-sleeve shirt with carbon fiber blend
- [Standard overshoes](https://albiox.com/product/standard-overshoes): Type 5 & 6 microporous overshoes for cleanroom chemical protection

- [Cytotoxic spill kits with gloves & gown](https://albiox.com/product/cytotoxic-spill-kit-with-size-7-5-latex-glove-medium-gown): Berner Cytotoxic Spill Kit with CE-marked PPE for hazardous spill cleanup

- [N10 Manual alkaline detergent](https://albiox.com/product/n10-manual-alkaline-detergent): InSpec N10 alkaline detergent for cleanroom surface cleaning (GMP)
